Title: Azure Site Recovery available in Brazil South

Body.Content: Azure Site Recovery is available in Brazil South with the same service-level agreement coverage available in other regions worldwide. Azure Site Recovery helps you protect your critical  applications by coordinating the replication and recovery of private clouds across sites. With Azure Site Recovery you can use Azure as your disaster recovery site and avoid the expense and complexity of building and managing your own secondary location. For more information about regional availability for services, visit our Azure Regions page. You can also learn more on the Azure Site Recovery page.
